answer: Proof-of-Stake protocols mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral, ensuring that identity creation is not a hollow exercise in generating keys but a costly commitment of resources. The ripple effect of slashing mechanisms ensures that misbehavior destroys the economic timber of the attacker, as losing staked assets makes each additional fraudulent node exponentially more expensive to maintain, rendering large-scale fake-identity proliferation economically irrational.
